steps.what: Read the defect card before this report.
Judge the defective equipment on this truck.
Write defective equipment reports from what is wrong.

tasks.design: A yard colleague writes a paper defect card with the truck number, the part name, and the report title. The collector reads it, judges the defect, and writes the report by hand. The card does not hold the fault.
tasks.previous_blocker: The truck list sat apart from the blank report, so the search was slow.
tasks.enabler_now: A paper card names the truck. The judgement and the report stay as they are.
tasks.still_hard: What is wrong still depends on the truck in the yard.
tasks.human_edge: Only the collector can judge the defect and what to write.
tasks.altitude: A card shortens finding the truck. The collector still judges the defect and writes the report.

reach.task: Write one defect note for a truck.
reach.learn: The card names the truck. The cleaner still judges the defect and writes the note.

evidence.claim: A paper card with the truck number, the part name, and the report title shortens the search. The collector still judges the defect and writes the report. Model knowledge of this design.

assumptions: The workplace is a mid-size European refuse yard.
A yard colleague writes the defect card before the report.
Fields are the truck number, the part name, and the report title.
The defect card does not hold the fault.
The collector judges the defect and writes the report at full time.
The written defect report is the collector's own writing. It is not posted anywhere else.
If the row is missing, the collector reads the paper yard list inside s1.
There is no native system to configure and no custom code.
Focal upkeep is zero because a yard colleague keeps the card, counted on the other line.
Staff consent for a monitoring or recording tool is out of scope because this design adds none.
unknowns: Whether this yard already keeps a one-line card for each truck.
research_questions: How often the defect card has no row on the first report.

incremental.description: No extra collector upkeep. A yard colleague keeps the card.
A yard colleague writes the defect card: truck number, part name, and report title.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The report is the first one, so the defect card has no row and the collector reads the paper yard list. The search saving disappears.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Tag a container to tell the customer the problem.

steps.what: Read the tag card before this stop.
Tag garbage or recycling containers to inform customers of problems, such as excess garbage or inclusion of items that are not permitted.

tasks.design: A yard colleague writes a paper tag card with the street name, the round name, and the tag pile. The collector reads it, judges the container, and hangs a paper tag. The card does not hold this customer's problem.
tasks.previous_blocker: The tag pile sat apart from the round list, so the search was slow.
tasks.enabler_now: A paper card names the street and the tag pile. The tag stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: What the container holds still depends on the stop.
tasks.human_edge: Only the collector can judge the problem and hang the tag.
tasks.altitude: A card shortens finding the tag pile. The collector still judges the container and hangs the tag.

reach.task: Tag one container the customer will see.
reach.learn: The card names the street. The worker still judges the problem and hangs the tag.

evidence.claim: A paper card with the street name, the round name, and the tag pile shortens the search. The collector still judges the container and hangs the tag. Model knowledge of this design.

assumptions: The workplace is a mid-size European refuse yard.
A yard colleague writes the tag card before the stop.
Fields are the street name, the round name, and the tag pile.
The tag card does not hold this customer's problem.
The collector judges the container and hangs the paper tag at full time.
The hung paper tag is the collector's own writing. It is not posted anywhere else.
If the row is missing, the collector reads the paper round list inside s1.
There is no native system to configure and no custom code.
Focal upkeep is zero because a yard colleague keeps the card, counted on the other line.
Staff consent for a monitoring or recording tool is out of scope because this design adds none.

role.altitude: The refuse collector still judges defects and writes the report, still calls dispatch, still checks the road and weather, and still tags containers. A card only shortens finding the truck, the channel, the route, or the tag pile.
reach: Cleaners of Vehicles and Equipment: judge one defect after the card names the truck.
Light Truck Drivers: call dispatch after the card names the channel.
Heavy and Tractor-Trailer Truck Drivers: check one route after the card names it.
Recycling and Reclamation Workers: tag one container after the card names the street.
skills_to_grow: Open the paper yard list when the card has no row.
Judge the defect, the route, and the container from the street, not from the card.
role.ambitious_version: Cards do not judge a defect, call dispatch, check the weather, or tag a container. The refuse collector still does.
